references.text: God saw all that he had made, and behold, it was very good. Parallel to Moses seeing all the work that was completed and that it was done according to the Lord's command.
God blessed the seventh day. Parallel to Moses blessing the people after the work on the tabernacle was completed.
The Lord commanded Moses to make the tabernacle exactly according to the pattern he showed him. This verse confirms that the work was carried out as the Lord had commanded.
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him. Repeats the theme of obedience to the Lord's commands.
The Aaronic blessing. Moses blessed the people, just as priests would later bless Israel.
Aron lifted his hands and blessed the people after completing the sacrificial service. Parallel to Moses' blessing after the work was finished.
Moses, the man of God, blessed the children of Israel before his death. Shows Moses' role as the one who blesses the people.
The priests serve in a sanctuary that is a picture and shadow of the heavenly one, just as Moses was told to make everything according to the pattern he was shown on the mountain.
Parallel thematic focus on the nation's total obedience at different stages: completion of the sanctuary and organization of the camp.
Direct narrative connection; 39:32 concludes the work, while 39:43 confirms the same with Moses' authoritative blessing.
